subject: General
notes: Rule: "If the access mode is dynamic, records in the file may be accessed sequentially, randomly, or both." (cite.py --check 12.4.5.5.3 -> OK §12.4.5.5.3 4)). Probes at --std 85 and 2023: INDEXED DYNAMIC -- random WRITEs out of key order succeed (C1,A3,B2 status 00), READ KEY IS IXD-KEY='B' -> B2 00, then READ NEXT -> C1 00 (gA.cob); RELATIVE ACCESS IS DYNAMIC -- RK=2 random READ -> R2 00, READ NEXT -> R5 00 with RK updated to 05 (gB.cob). Both sequential and random access, mixed on one open, work for both keyed organizations. No spec-derived golden cited. [registrar 14a — editions as adjudicated: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023 (Annex E lists no substantive change to the ACCESS MODE clause)]
